name: Chikan Yuugi
source:
A school city project is realized with the help of private companies. Main character runs a website "OZ" to coordinate molester actions targeted at girls coming to school by train.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在民間企業的協助下，學園都市的建設計畫得以實現。主角經營著名為「OZ」的網站，專門聯絡、組織猥褻者，在通學電車上對女學生下手。
